about.mission.eu.title: European infrastructure
about.mission.eu.body: Your page, files and data run on European servers. No American cloud, no reselling, under European law.
about.mission.trackers.title: Zero trackers
about.mission.trackers.body: No ad pixels, no cookie wall, no fingerprinting. Visitors to your profile are not tracked, not even by us.
about.mission.privacy.title: Privacy first
about.mission.privacy.body: SecureShield hides your real e-mail address and you decide what is public. Export or erase your data with one click.
about.mission.identity.title: Sovereign identity
about.mission.identity.body: One name, one clean link, verified by people. Your identity is yours and moves with you to your own domain.
